Info magang dari Bina Karya Prima Group

Hi Future Professionals! 👋

Bina Karya Prima Group (home to Tropical cooking oil, ForVita margarine, Shinzu'i soap, and more) is excited to announce an opening for 'Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Intern' and 'Finance Intern' at our Head Office in North Jakarta!

Are you passionate about people, recruitment, employer branding, or financial management? Whether you enjoy connecting with people, exploring creative ideas to strengthen employer branding, or working with numbers and financial data, we want YOU to join PT Bina Karya Prima's PRIMA People! ✨

If you are eager to learn, detail-oriented, proactive, and excited to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic working environment, this is your opportunity to grow, sharpen your skills, and kick-start your career with us!

If you're ready to become part of our team, send your CV in PDF format via email to jesslyn.nathalee@bkpprima.co.id with the subject line:
"[Position] Intern - [Your Full Name]"

📍 Placement: Head Office, Sunter, North Jakarta
⏳ Duration: 6 Months
🏢 Working Arrangement: WFO (Work From Office) for 6 Months
💵 Internship Type: Paid Internship

Learn more about our values and commitment to excellence at www.binakaryaprima.com
We look forward to welcoming you to PRIMA People! ✨
